title: Initialize Supabase Client
description: Setting up the Supabase client in your application.
explanation_md: Initializes the Supabase client using your project URL and public API key. Usually stored in environment variables for security.

title: Fetch Data with Filters
description: Querying a table with multiple conditions.
code:
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('countries')
  .select('*')
  .eq('continent', 'Europe')
  .gt('population', 10000000)
  .order('name', { ascending: true });
explanation_md: Supabase provides a fluent API for building SQL queries, including filtering (`eq`, `gt`) and sorting (`order`).

title: Auth: Sign Up with Email
description: Registering a new user using email and password.
explanation_md: Handles user registration. Supabase automatically sends a confirmation email if configured.

title: Realtime Subscriptions
description: Listen for database changes in real-time.
explanation_md: Uses Supabase Realtime to subscribe to inserts, updates, or deletes on a specific database table.

title: Upload to Storage
description: Uploading a file to a Supabase Storage bucket.
explanation_md: Uploads a file to a specific bucket. The `upsert` option determines whether to overwrite existing files.
